seo.title: Workspaces — SolPrompter
seo.description: Your saved teleprompter scripts. Open a workspace to record, or start a new script — everything stays private on your device.

sidebar.creditsText: Free, no ads — your scripts and recordings stay private on your device.

empty.title: No scripts yet
